 Print Katy Perry has found herself back in the spotlight, but this time it is not just her romance with former Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau making headlines. A cheery selfie of the singer posing with Trudeau and French President Emmanuel Macron in Paris has been doing the rounds online. In the photograph, Katy is seen flashing a broad smile as she poses between Trudeau and Macron. The singer has been accompanying her boyfriend on his European visit, for his engagements across Barcelona, Milan and Paris. Watch Shocking: Katy Perry Rushes To Aid Fainting Fan At Detroit Concert | Watch However, the spotting coincides with renewed attention on her past marriage to British comedian Russell Brand following the release of newly unsealed court documents. Russell Brand's deposition makes headlines
 The selfie comes after fresh revelations from a deposition given by Brand last year in connection with a civil lawsuit filed in New York. According to court documents obtained by the Daily Mail, the comedian was questioned about an alleged incident involving a woman who claimed that he exposed himself to her while filming his 2011 movie 'Arthur' and later sexually assaulted her in a bathroom. During the deposition, Brand was asked about his relationship with Perry and whether they were married when the alleged incident took place. According to the transcript filed with the New York Supreme Court, Brand appeared unable to recall the exact timeline of their relationship. "I was — what I do know is that I was in a relationship with, as you know, obviously a very high-profile woman. And even when I was married to her, I was sort of drowning in love," he said. The alleged incident is said to have taken place in July 2010, approximately three months before Brand and Perry married. The allegations made by the woman are part of a separate civil lawsuit.  Katy Perry and Russell Brand's marriage back in the spotlight
 Perry and Brand first met in 2009 when the singer made a cameo appearance in the comedian's film 'Get Him to the Greek'. They began dating later that year and married in October 2010 in India. However, their relationship ended the following year, with their divorce being finalised in 2012. Brand's marriage to Perry was also kept out of his recent criminal trial in the UK after his legal team successfully challenged the prosecution's attempt to refer to the relationship during its opening arguments, arguing that it was irrelevant to the charges. Brand was subsequently convicted of one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault in the UK. He was acquitted of other charges and sentenced to 10 years and six months in prison.
